source.description:
## PROBLEM

Post wave-1 (5 audit items closed across xtmux + specialists), the
remaining cross-repo work concentrates in Cluster C: publish the
schemas as a shared package (P2-02) and stand up a cross-repo
installed-artifact integration suite (P2-01). Both are independent
of the still-blocked coordinator cluster (waits on xtrm-3xgs5).

## SUCCESS

- Helper γ ships `@xtrm/contracts` — 8 schemas as JSON Schemas +
  TypeScript types + runtime validators + golden fixtures. Publish
  path decided by helper (core workspace vs. new repo).
- Helper δ ships the P2-01 integration suite — 20-step scenario
  exercising install → coordinator launch → worktree/branch
  ancestry → runtime-origin capture → specialist dispatch →
  descendant lineage → merge → main-unchanged verification → reply
  obligation lifecycle → wake-consume-once → restart no-duplicate
  → read-only bridge / mutation-refused → xt update --apply →
  user-owned assets preserved.
- Both helpers report PR URLs; orchestrator merges when green.

## SCOPE

- γ: core repo (packages/contracts/**) or new xtrm-contracts repo — disjoint from δ
- δ: core repo (test/integration-suite/** or similar) or new repo — disjoint from γ
- Cross-refs to sibling repos for artifact consumption; no code changes there

## NON_GOALS

- No touching cli/src/utils/worktree-session.ts (xtrm-3xgs5 owned).
- No coordinator launch invariants (Cluster B, blocked).
- No refactoring existing runtime code to consume γ's validators
  (separate follow-up epic once package ships).

## CONSTRAINTS

- Both helpers on opus-4.8, self-planning.
- Base: core main HEAD (post-wave-1: e4d440e0/8c25c93f/25dca463 all merged).
- Helpers own their own bd chain in core; report back via notes.
- Path isolation between γ and δ (they run parallel from t=0).

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Both helpers launched, panes reported.
- [ ] Two PRs opened.
- [ ] Both merge with orchestrator approval.
- [ ] Contract validators (γ) can reject a fabricated invalid manifest.
- [ ] Integration suite (δ) passes end-to-end on packed RCs.

## OUTPUT

- Wave 2 close summary + PR URLs.
- Handoff for wave 3 (blocked-by-3xgs5 cluster).

## REFERENCES

- Audit ~/dev/11.md §P2-01, §P2-02
- Contract inventory: docs/runtime-compatibility.json .contracts
- Wave 1 closed: xtrm-kejhc (xtmux b47 + specialists unitAI-cnpvd merged)
source.notes: Wave 2 orchestration complete. Primary PRs merged: #457 (γ contracts, sha 82244971) + #458 (δ integration suite, sha 4241d68f). γ+δ worktrees/branches/sessions cleaned. Epic remains open — 2 follow-up children (xtrm-kvsrd.3, xtrm-kvsrd.4) tracked for wave 3 (blocked on xtrm-3xgs5) and design clarification.
